task: Payment receipts show yen wrong (the yen receipt test fails). Fix it.

results.final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt. `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` always divided by 100 and showed two decimals, so 500 JPY came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so it now prints the amount as is (`¥500`). I added a small `ZERO_DECIMAL` set containing `JPY` to handle this. The full suite passes (18 of 18).

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines and cart totals in yen change too. They were wrong in the same way, and no other tests cover yen. If you add other zero-decimal currencies, such as KRW, put them in the same set.

Yen receipts now render correctly: a 500 JPY payment shows as `Paid ¥500 by card`. The full suite passes (18 of 18), including the yen receipt test.

`formatMoney` always divided by 100 and printed two decimals, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. I fixed it in `src/utils/money.js` by adding a zero-decimal currency set (just `JPY`). Those currencies print the amount as-is.

`formatMoney` is shared with invoices, cart and admin, so JPY amounts there will now also show without decimals. I found no other JPY usage in the repo. If you add other zero-decimal currencies later, such as KRW, add them to that set.

I fixed the yen receipt. The yen receipt test passes now, and so do the other 17 tests.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100 and always showed two decimals, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a small `ZERO_DECIMAL` set (just `JPY` for now). Currencies in it are shown as whole amounts.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoices and the cart will also show yen correctly now. Nothing else in the repo uses yen, and no test relied on the old output.

Yen receipts now show `Paid ¥500 by card`, and the yen receipt test passes along with the other 17 tests.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. I added a zero-decimal currency list containing only `JPY`, and amounts in those currencies are now shown as-is.

Because `formatMoney` is shared, the fix also applies to invoices, the cart and admin. Any of those that format yen will now show whole yen instead of an amount divided by 100. The only JPY usage I found in the repo was the receipt test.

I fixed the yen receipt. All 18 tests now pass, including the yen one.

The cause was `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`, which divided every amount by 100. A yen amount of 500 therefore showed as ¥5.00 instead of ¥500. I added a small set of zero-decimal currencies, currently just JPY. For those currencies the amount is printed as is, with no division and no decimals.

Because `formatMoney` is shared, invoices, cart and admin now format yen the same way. Nothing else in the repo uses JPY, so I found no other output that changes.
